Official ECU Pirates Shop: East Carolina Gifts, Gear and Pirates Apparel

Browse our complete selection of Officially Licensed ECU Pirates Apparel and Merchandise at the ECU Pirates Athletics Store. Choose from the best selection of ECU gear and apparel to help you look forward to the next season as well. Men, women and youth can all shop ECU Pirates Gear from the Official ECU Pirates Shop, with everything from gameday clothing to home and office decorations. Check out our ECU Pirates Clothing, Gear, Accessories and Tailgate Supplies to make sure you’re ready to cheer on ECU. You're sure to find the officially licensed ECU Pirates Athletics Gear you want at the official ECU Pirates Shop. Go Pirates!

ECU Pirates Football Gear

Show your ECU Pirates pride with officially licensed ECU football gear from the ECU Pirates Athletics Store. Celebrate the passion and power of East Carolina University football with our collection of apparel and merchandise, perfect for die-hard fans. From game day essentials to casual wear, we’ve got you covered. Gear up in purple and gold and show your support for the Pirates as they charge down the field to victory!

ECU Basketball Apparel

Step up your game with officially licensed East Carolina Pirates basketball gear from the ECU Pirates Athletics Store. Whether you’re cheering courtside or watching from home, our selection of ECU apparel and merchandise will have you decked out in true Pirate spirit. Represent East Carolina University’s hard-hustling basketball tradition with jerseys, hats, and more. Gear up and show your pride as the Pirates take on their rivals and fight for every win on the court!

East Carolina Baseball & Softball Merch

Celebrate the diamond dominance of East Carolina Pirates baseball gear and ECU softball gear with officially licensed merchandise from the ECU Pirates Athletics Store. Show your support with our exclusive collection of ECU apparel and merchandise, perfect for every true Pirate fan. Whether you’re cheering from the stands or playing your own game, our selection of jerseys, hats, and more lets you represent East Carolina University with pride. Gear up and join the legacy of Pirate excellence!
